summary: Iteration 5 targeted bug-fix verification: (1) Homepage Browse.jsx polling picks up backend is_live flips within ~12s without a hard refresh, (2) filter chips (live-only, category) still work under the poll, (3) Dashboard CUT SIGNAL button correctly flips is_live=false + viewer_count=0 and swaps UI back to FORCE LIVE, (4) backend Livepeer webhook regression (test_new_features.py::TestNotifications) still passes. All four scenarios PASS.

test_results.homepage_poll_offline_to_live: PASS — testdj card had 0 LIVE badges baseline; after stream.started webhook + 13s wait, LIVE badge appeared without navigation/refresh
test_results.homepage_poll_live_to_offline: PASS — after stream.idle webhook + 13s wait, LIVE badge disappeared from testdj card without refresh
test_results.filter_regression_live_only: PASS — with testdj live, LIVE-ONLY filter shows 2 cards including testdj
test_results.filter_regression_category: PASS — category=music returns 11 cards; category=all restores full grid
test_results.dashboard_cut_signal: PASS — clicked FORCE LIVE (channel went LIVE, ON AIR badge visible, CUT SIGNAL button appeared) then clicked CUT SIGNAL: FORCE LIVE button returned, ON AIR gone, OFF AIR shown, toast 'SIGNAL CUT.' displayed
test_results.dashboard_cut_signal_backend_state: PASS — GET /api/channels/mine returned is_live=false, viewer_count=0 immediately after button click

critical_code_review_comments: Browse.jsx polling implementation is clean: uses `initial` guard so the skeleton only shows on first fetch, and clearInterval + cancelled flag on unmount avoid state-update-on-unmounted-component warnings.
Poll interval (10s) is reasonable; when the user filters, the effect re-subscribes and the very next tick uses the fresh params — verified in filter regression.
Dashboard.jsx already has its own 8s poll for auto-detect, so operator UI also self-heals when webhook flips state — good.

Minor: Browse.jsx polls unconditionally even when the tab is hidden. Consider `document.visibilityState === 'visible'` gate to save unnecessary requests on backgrounded tabs (optional optimization, not a bug).
seed_data_creation: None. testdj is_live was flipped LIVE/OFFLINE several times via signed webhook + button clicks during the test. Final DB state confirmed via API: is_live=false, viewer_count=0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified end-to-end. Homepage polling works, filters unaffected, CUT SIGNAL button both updates UI and DB. If future changes to Browse.jsx polling, keep the initial-load skeleton guard and cancelled cleanup; those prevent flicker and memory leaks respectively.
rca of the issue: Original bug: card visually stuck as LIVE after OBS stops streaming even though backend correctly flipped is_live=false via Livepeer webhook. RCA: Homepage Browse.jsx fetched /api/channels only on mount — no polling — so it never observed subsequent backend flips. Reproduction path was: view homepage → backend flips is_live → homepage still shows LIVE until manual reload. Fix (in Browse.jsx): added setInterval(load, 10000) alongside the initial load, with an `initial` guard to prevent the skeleton from re-showing, and a cancelled/clearInterval cleanup on unmount. Verified: 13s after a stream.started webhook, the LIVE badge appears; 13s after stream.idle, it disappears — all without navigation.
